confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from web search summaries of crowdsourced cost-of-living data for Pai. Numbeo gave a cappuccino median of about 59 THB and a domestic draft beer around 80 THB (range 50-120). Other aggregators put an inexpensive meal at 40-100 THB (about $2-2.10) and a mid-range dinner for two at 300-800 THB, with one source near $24. I converted using an assumed rate of about 32-33 THB per USD, so the USD values depend on that rate. I moved the inexpensive-meal figure slightly higher because Walking Street and tourist-area prices are higher than market stalls. The searches found no reliable aggregated prices for cocktails, only undated venue promotions such as 80 THB cocktail specials. I found no wine data at all. The cocktail and wine anchors are therefore estimates based on the usual Thai ratio of about 2x the draft beer price, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge only and did not come from any search or listing. They assume July 2026 is green and low season, when rates in Pai are usually lower than in the November-February high season. The FX figure is the RBA 4.00 pm reference rate for 18 November 2026, which is the latest observation available when this was generated, not a July 2026 rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Pai is a small backpacker and tourist town in Mae Hong Son province. It is similar to Chiang Mai's Old City and to other northern Thai tourist towns, but food and accommodation are slightly cheaper. Its tourist bar strip charges prices for drinks similar to other backpacker centres in Thailand.
